elements.manual_reason: The black dot expands into the full-bleed dark background; no candidate box covers the whole frame.
elements.label: Expanding black dot to dark background

sfx_review.label: impact
sfx_review.note: Lands as the dot covers the frame and the scene flips from light to dark; low broadband hit and a change in the music texture. CLAP said glitch, but there is no stutter pattern.

pattern.description: The black dot keeps scaling until it covers the frame (a circular wipe to a dark, dot-grid background), then 'Everything' settles in at the centre: it fades in slightly large and low, then drifts up and shrinks to rest.
pattern.why_premium: The circular wipe reuses the dot from the previous beat as the transition, so the light-to-dark flip feels motivated. The single word then lands with a gentle settle (drift plus scale-down) instead of a plain fade, with the impact SFX on the flip.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.dot', {scale: 20, duration: 0.13, ease: 'power3.in'}); tl.set('.bg', {backgroundColor: '#0f1013'}); tl.fromTo('.headline', {autoAlpha: 0, y: 30, scale: 1.15}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, scale: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out'}, '+=0.05').
build_hint.remotion: Dot scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 4], [1, 20], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.cubic)}); headline from frame 7: spring({frame: frame - 7, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120}}) drives opacity 0->1, translateY 30->0 and scale 1.15->1 (no overshoot).

notes: The pattern combines a circular mask wipe with a word reveal; I picked kinetic_word_reveal for the end state, but the wipe carries most of the motion energy. The x001 impact belongs to both e004 and e005 (offset -167 ms here). The faint dot-grid background appears with the wipe.
